Bootstrap a Debian Trixie base filesystem.

## Configurations

Architecture-specific configurations replace the default configuration. The
default is used when no matching architecture override exists.

### Default

| Setting    | Value              |
| ---------- | ------------------ |
| Root layer | Yes                |
| Recipes    | `debian-bootstrap` |

| Recipe             | Parameter | Value      |
| ------------------ | --------- | ---------- |
| `debian-bootstrap` | `suite`   | `"trixie"` |

## Behavior

Builds a fresh root filesystem with core/debian-bootstrap and selects the Trixie
suite. Extend this layer with application recipes and the boot setup required by
the target device.

## Example

For example, choose this base for a project layer:

```toml
parent = "core/debian-trixie"
```
